title: Transmission System Subsystem Static Attributes
description: Static attributes of the transmission system, responsible for distributing input power to various output ends.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference path, used for editor intelligent suggestions and validation

basic_durability.description: Subsystem basic durability, becomes paralyzed when reduced to 0, restores functionality when repaired to 30% durability.

pass_damage.description: Whether to pass damage to the subsystem holder. If true, damage received by the subsystem will be transferred to the sub-part.

limit_damage.description: Whether to limit damage transfer value to the subsystem's remaining durability. For example, 40 damage with 20 remaining durability will only transfer 20 damage to the holder.

hidden.description: Whether to hide the subsystem in HUD displays, commonly used for purely providing model part damage differentiation for non-functional subsystems

diff_lock.description: Differential lock mode. true: always locked; false: never locked; auto: automatically locked; manual: manually controlled locking.

diff_lock_sensitivity.description: Limited-slip strength. The speed loop clamps it to 0~1: higher values approach a rigid lock (1 pulls a slipping output back to the synchronous speed immediately), 0 applies no drag. The same value also acts as the coupling coefficient of differential lock torque transfer, where it is not clamped.

auto_diff_lock_threshold.description: Automatic differential lock threshold. When the deviation of an output end feedback speed from the average feedback speed exceeds this percentage and diff_lock is auto, the differential lock is enabled automatically.

control_inputs.description: List of signal channel names for manual differential lock control, in descending priority. Read only when diff_lock is manual.

on_destroyed.description: Sound event when the subsystem is destroyed.

on_activate.description: Sound event when the subsystem is activated.

sounds.description: Basic sound configuration for the subsystem.
